basis: Literature review: Parallel deep-research sweep, Sept 2026. Citations per dimension. Rubric encodes evidence-informed priors, not objective truth — weights are versioned and reweighted by marketplace outcomes over time.

scoring.note: Each voice is rated 0-1 on each neutral dimension. Archetypes define a target level + weight per dimension. Fit = 1 - weighted mean |level - target|. 'More' is not always 'better' — medium rate and moderate expressiveness win for comprehension-heavy tasks (Rodero et al. 2022).

arousal.label: energy/arousal
arousal.description: Emotional activation and intensity of delivery — low is soothing/unhurried, high is excited/intense.
arousal.citation: Rodero et al. 2022 (expressive load vs arousal); Marty-Dugas 2024 (enthusiasm→engagement); Huangfu et al. 2025 (high enthusiasm can harm learning under cognitive load)

pace.label: speech rate
pace.description: How fast the delivery feels — slow/measured vs quick/driving.
pace.citation: Rodero et al. 2022 (~180wpm medium rate optimal for recall/recognition; inverted-U, not monotonic)

expressiveness.label: intonation/expressive load
expressiveness.description: Pitch variation and dramatic range — flat/neutral vs animated/emphatic.
expressiveness.citation: Rodero et al. 2022 (moderate intonation → credibility+effectiveness; emphatic → arousal+attention only)

warmth.label: warmth/approachability
warmth.description: How warm, reassuring, and approachable the delivery feels.
warmth.citation: Belin, Boehme & McAleer 2017 (trustworthiness contour: high onset, mid-utterance fall, final rise)

authority.label: authority/gravitas
authority.description: Perceived status, expertise, and commanding presence — not a proxy for competence.
authority.citation: Klofstad, Anderson & Peters 2012 (lower pitch → leadership judgments); acoustic-authority 2026 (loudness/intensity → perceived power; weak for actual persuasion)

intimacy.label: intimacy/closeness
intimacy.description: Close, personal, soft-spoken delivery vs broadcast-style projection.
intimacy.citation: Weak direct evidence — breathiness→intimacy claims are thinner than popular advice suggests (Schiller et al. 2024). Included at low weight only; flagged for outcome-validation.

excluded_dimensions.gender: Stereotype risk in both directions; no universal preference (Piercy et al. 2025). Never encoded.
excluded_dimensions.accent_hierarchy: Accent = audience-congruence, never prestige ranking. Synthetic-voice studies show fluency effects but no consistent competence/warmth bias (Hercula et al. 2024).
excluded_dimensions.vocal_fry_penalty: Context-bound labor-market effect (Anderson et al. 2014); not a general quality signal — excluded to avoid laundering bias.

outcome_learning.note: The rubric is a prior. Log brief → ranked → previewed → vocalized → purchased events; reweight dimension weights by observed conversion. Behavioral outcomes are the ground truth this rubric approximates.
